mods.overviewImportantTitle: Removing mods and your Workshop subscription
mods.overviewImportantP1: Deleting a mod folder on disk (or opening it from here) does not unsubscribe you from that item on the Steam Workshop.
mods.overviewImportantP2: If you remain subscribed, the Steam client may download the mod again. To remove it permanently, unsubscribe on the item's Workshop page, or from your subscribed Workshop items in the Steam client (for example Library → Workshop).
mods.overviewListIntro: How this section gets its data:
mods.overviewBulletMeta: The list is built from installed folders under steamapps/workshop/content/<appid>, using each mod's meta.cpp. Set the Steam root folder in Settings.
mods.overviewBulletAcf: The Steam (acf) columns read only steamapps/workshop/appworkshop_<appid>.acf when present; the launcher does not modify that file.
